lines.en: I move my body along unhurriedly

lines.zh: 这具小小的躯体贴着地爬
lines.en: This little body crawls along the ground

lines.zh: 我拖着半透明的赘生物走
lines.en: I drag my translucent growth along

lines.zh: 湿润的痕迹留在我身后
lines.en: A wet trail stays behind me
One step carries me half a block
I head where there is moisture in the air
My trunk swells and contracts
The fleshy tendrils on me sway

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，但走得很稳
lines.en: I have no bones, yet I walk steady
I sniff the damp marks on the ground

lines.zh: 我慢慢把自己挪过石头
lines.en: I slowly work myself over the stone

lines.zh: 我用肉质的腹面推着走
lines.en: I push along on my fleshy underside
I crawl over a patch of damp moss
My tendrils reach out first, then pull
I creep along the base of the wall

lines.zh: 每次挪动都挤出一点水
lines.en: Each move squeezes out a little water
I shrink into the corner and stay still
My surface rises and falls gently
I wait for prey to come near on its own
My tendrils hang and drip
The light here is too bright
I flatten myself a little
I listen to the sounds around me

lines.zh: 半透明的皮在微微发亮
lines.en: My translucent skin glows faintly
I am slowly mending myself
A breeze passes, and my tendrils sway.

lines.zh: 我的表面浮起一些小泡
lines.en: Small bubbles rise on my surface
I lay my tendrils on the damp soil
I am as still as a clump of wet mud

lines.zh: 我在等体内的东西消化
lines.en: I wait for what is inside me to digest
There is a small thing at your feet
You are already in my sight
You are easier to chase than a villager
I am small, but I have teeth
You have to look down to see me
I will run after you
This patch of ground is mine
You've smeared the wet trail I left.
Bit by bit, I creep to your feet.
When you lift your foot, I dash
My body has been squashed flat
A split opened in my body
Tissue is leaking out
I tighten myself up

lines.zh: 这点伤我会慢慢长回来
lines.en: I will slowly grow back from this
Two of my tendrils broke

lines.zh: 我发出一种很低的声音
lines.en: I make a very low sound
This small body cannot take hits
I retreat into the shade to mend
My movements have slowed
Is that for me to eat
You lowered it
It smells sweet. My tendrils twitch.
I crawl that way
This smells better than meat
I extend one tendril to test it
My body has swollen a bit
A little lower, I cannot reach
You crouched down with it

lines.zh: 我贴着它的鞋绕了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half around its boot.
You flattened me a little
I puff back out at once
We bumped and it is slippery
Your foot slid over my body

lines.zh: 我退了半格，重新鼓起来
lines.en: I move back half a block and swell up again

lines.zh: 你撞我的时候我缩了一下
lines.en: I shrank when you hit me
This thing is softer than stone
I pressed past you
You smeared my wet trail
One touch and we part
Such matters do not concern me

lines.zh: 我的身体能自己长出新的
lines.en: My body can grow new ones on its own
I need only water and tissue
You need not ask

lines.zh: 海嗣的数量不需要仪式
lines.en: Seaborn numbers need no ceremony
I draw my tendrils in

lines.zh: 我摇头，整个身体都在晃
lines.en: I shake my head and my whole body wobbles

lines.zh: 我朝水汽更浓的地方去
lines.en: I head where the moisture is thicker
I cannot answer that
I crawl on that way
I wrap it into my body
I curl a tendril around it
I can swallow this
I want all the scraps on the ground
It dissolved a little inside me
I drag it into the shade
This thing is too small
I curl it up and absorb it slowly
My body glowed once
Not enough for me to grow
I smell villagers
The iron kind, I do not fear them

lines.zh: 我先锁住最靠前的那个
lines.en: I lock the nearest one first
I break into a small run
Seven damage will do
Every tendril on me unfurls

lines.zh: 那个方向有一个落单的
lines.en: There is a lone one in that direction

lines.zh: 我拖着自己的身体加速
lines.en: I drag my body into a faster pace
This prey will not get far
I move first, do not blame me
Belly to the ground, I give chase.
You run faster, but you will tire
Everywhere I crawl is left wet.
You looked back at me
I keep my wet body to the floor
I will come under your feet
Jumping onto stone will not help
I follow you without letting go
I mark every step you take
A few more steps and you reach the wall
I bite your ankle
I fling my whole body at you

lines.zh: 七点伤害来自这张小嘴
lines.en: Seven damage comes from this small mouth
I cling to your leg
I bump and retreat
My tendrils wrap your shoe
This bite is very quick
I drop back down and swell up again
You kick me off, I crawl back
I hurl myself between its legs
I bulge up out of the wet mud
Half of me emerges from the ground first
I have only twenty health

lines.zh: 这片地上的水分正合我意
lines.en: The moisture here suits me

lines.zh: 我是被带来的，不是自己来的
lines.en: I was brought here, I did not come myself
My body is still taking shape
The air around has turned damp

lines.zh: 我慢慢撑开自己的身体
lines.en: I slowly spread my body open

lines.zh: 我的名字是潮渐赘生物
lines.en: My name is the Tidutant Excrescence
I begin to stretch out along the ground
Fire dried out my outer layer

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下去，摊开了
lines.en: I fell off the stone and spread out flat

lines.zh: 水对我来说是好的，但太多也会闷
lines.en: Water is good for me, but too much stifles
The blast scattered me entirely
An arrow pierced my body
That magic burns inside me

lines.zh: 我还没吸收到东西，正在变薄
lines.en: I have absorbed nothing and am thinning

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我一下子僵了
lines.en: Lightning struck and I went rigid
I dropped off the face of the ground
